title: {Syn} Quasicrystals Broke the Old Crystal Rulebook
content:
Quasicrystals have ordered patterns that do not repeat periodically like ordinary crystals. Their discovery changed the definition of what a crystal could be.

The math connection is tiling: nonperiodic order can still be highly structured, which is why Penrose-style patterns are a helpful mental image.

Why it matters: science facts keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
